kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تحقوا (form I)
# تَحِقُّوا (taḥiqqū) /ta.ħiq.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# تَحُقُّوا (taḥuqqū) /ta.ħuq.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# تُحَقُّوا (tuḥaqqū) /tu.ħaq.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
